walkthrough:
Differentiate the curve equation with respect to $x$:
$$\frac{dy}{dx} = 3x^2 + 2x - 8$$

Set $\frac{dy}{dx} = 0$ to find the stationary points:
$$3x^2 + 2x - 8 = 0 \implies (3x - 4)(x + 2) = 0 \implies x = -2 \quad \text{and} \quad x = \frac{4}{3}$$

The open interval containing no stationary points between these two locations is $-2 < x < \frac{4}{3}$:
$$\text{Least possible value: } a = -2$$
$$\text{Greatest possible value: } b = \frac{4}{3}$$
